description: What a year (1800-2025) looked like in numbers, from outside sources rather than encyclopedia prose: world population, U.S. CPI and what a dollar then is worth now, average U.S. prices (gas, eggs, bread, milk, houses, income, minimum wage), who led the major powers, and the Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 songs. Every figure carries its source. For any other country's leaders use get_leaders.
name: get_year_facts
